# command: notify if a run is longer than X sec

Add a `notify` wrapper that raises a macOS notification when a long command finishes. **Motivation:** "better DX when I run long execution scripts" — start it, switch away, be told when it is done:

```bash
$ notify -5s go run main.go
# if go run main.go execution time >5s then exec
# osascript -e 'display notification "The command `go run main.go` is complete! Exec time... Status code..." with title "Script execution"'
```

The threshold avoids notifications for commands that finish quickly; the message should carry the command, the elapsed time and the exit status.
